maddeler.e:
يتفرنس (form IIq)
# يَتَفَرْنَسُ (yatafarnasu) /ja.ta.far.na.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
# يُتَفَرْنَسُ (yutafarnasu) /ju.ta.far.na.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
# يَتَفَرْنَسَ (yatafarnasa) /ja.ta.far.na.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
